kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنسكب (form VII)
# أَنْسَكِبُ (ʔansakibu) /ʔan.sa.ki.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْسَكَبَ (insakaba)
# أَنْسَكِبَ (ʔansakiba) /ʔan.sa.ki.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْسَكَبَ (insakaba)
# أَنْسَكِبْ (ʔansakib) /ʔan.sa.kib/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْسَكَبَ (insakaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
